assertions.assertion: The patient presents with a history of recurrent, unexplained episodes of syncope and presyncope, raising concern for an underlying paroxysmal cardiac arrhythmia.
To correlate these symptomatic events with potential rhythm disturbances, mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring is ordered for extended ambulatory assessment.
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring is consistent with CPT 93229.
The payer letter states that coverage for this diagnostic procedure mandates prior approval.
The claim for Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) has been denied.
The denial is based on Reason Code CO-197.
The required precertification or authorization was not obtained prior to the service date.
The clinical indication demonstrates a medically necessary presentation warranting mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring to correlate the symptomatic events with potential rhythm disturbances.
